dialogue.content: 今日はどんな相談でしょうか？年代と性別をお願い致します。
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today? Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。どんな相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。いつから行きたくない気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How long have you been feeling that you don't want to go?

dialogue.content: 先月からです
dialogue.English: Since last month.

dialogue.content: その頃何か出来事などありましたか？話せる範囲でいいですよ。
dialogue.English: Did anything happen around that time? You can share as much as you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: クラスメイトから避けられてる気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like my classmates are avoiding me.

dialogue.content: それは気分が良くありませんね。どんな時避けられた気がしました？
dialogue.English: That must not feel good. When did you feel like you were being avoided?

dialogue.content: 無視された時ですね
dialogue.English: When I was ignored.

dialogue.content: 無視されたら辛いですよね。その人はクラスのお友達で何人かの方ですか？
dialogue.English: It's painful to be ignored, isn't it? Are these people friends from your class? Is it more than one person?

dialogue.content: 友達ではないです。複数人ですね
dialogue.English: They're not friends. It's multiple people.

dialogue.content: 複数人の人でしたら悲しみも倍になりますね。どういう知り合いの人達でしょうか？
dialogue.English: If it's multiple people, that must be even more upsetting. What is your relationship with them?

dialogue.content: 同じクラスの人たちです
dialogue.English: They're people from my class.

dialogue.content: クラスではお話しする人はいなくて孤独感でいっぱいな気持ちなのですね。実際にどんな風に無視されたかお話しできたら聞かせてください。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you feel very lonely in class with no one to talk to. If you can, could you please tell me how exactly you were ignored?

dialogue.content: 話せる人がいないとは一言も言ってないのですが、、、授業のことについて聞いたら反応がないという感じですね
dialogue.English: I never said I don't have anyone to talk to... It's more like when I ask about classwork, I get no response.

dialogue.content: 反応がないと自分の居場所がないように感じられるかもしれませんね。他にはなせるお友達はクラスにいますか？
dialogue.English: When they don't respond, it might make you feel like you don't belong. Do you have other friends in class you can talk to?

dialogue.content: 話せないことはない人はいますが滅多に話しません
dialogue.English: There are people I can talk to, but I rarely do.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・あなたは授業のことを聞いたのになんとか授業にさしつかえはなかったでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see... You asked about the class, but were you able to manage without any problems in the lesson?

dialogue.content: 自分で調べました
dialogue.English: I looked it up myself.

dialogue.content: そうですか淋しいところなんとか過ごされたようですね。周りの人が無視するのは何かこころあたりはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you managed to get through that lonely moment. Do you have any idea why the people around you might be ignoring you?

dialogue.content: うーんこれと言ったきっかけは思いつかないのですが強いていうとしたら私がおかしいからだと思います
dialogue.English: Hmm, I can't think of a specific trigger, but if I had to say, it's probably because there's something wrong with me.

dialogue.content: あなたがおかしいというのは何がおかしいのですか？
dialogue.English: When you say there’s something wrong with you, what do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 言った方がいいですか？
dialogue.English: Should I say it?

dialogue.content: ええ出来ればお話ししてくださいね。どんな話でもいいですよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, please tell me if you can. Anything you’d like to share is fine.

dialogue.content: 絶対話さないとダメですか？
dialogue.English: Do I absolutely have to talk about it?

dialogue.content: 絶対はないですが、どんなことがおかしいのか聞かせて下さいね。小さなことからでいいですよ。
dialogue.English: Nothing is absolute, but please tell me what you feel is 'wrong' with you. You can start with something small.

dialogue.content: え？それって絶対話せってことですよね？
dialogue.English: Huh? That sounds like you're telling me I absolutely have to talk about it, right?

dialogue.content: 無理ならいいですよ。あなたが苦しんでいるなら少しでも理解できたらと思います。
dialogue.English: If it’s too hard, that’s okay. I just hope to understand, even a little, if you’re struggling.

dialogue.content: なんか冷たいですね
dialogue.English: That feels a bit cold.

dialogue.content: こんなに苦しい思いをされているようなのでここで少しでもお話しできたらいいですね。
dialogue.English: It seems you're going through such a hard time, so it would be good if we could talk about it a little here.

dialogue.content: 私の質問がおかしいから冷たいんですね。
dialogue.English: You're being cold because my question was weird, right?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさいね。そんな風にあなたは思っているのですね。周りの人達は何か実際に言っていますか？
dialogue.English: I’m sorry. So that’s how it feels to you. Have the people around you actually said anything?

dialogue.content: 特になにも言ってないです
dialogue.English: They haven't said anything in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなのですよね。先生にはこの事を話されましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked to your teacher about this?

dialogue.content: 話しましたが動いてくれそうにありません
dialogue.English: I did, but they don’t seem likely to take action.

dialogue.content: まぁ、それは頼りになる方がいないと失望していまいますよね。家族の方はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Well, that must be disappointing when there's no one you can rely on. What about your family?

dialogue.content: 同じです
dialogue.English: It's the same.

dialogue.content: 周りのクラスメートで学校を休んでいるあいだにラインなど連絡をくれた人がいるといいですが・・・
dialogue.English: It would be nice if any of your classmates had contacted you on an app like LINE while you've been absent from school...

dialogue.content: 私学校休んでるって言いましたっけ？
dialogue.English: Did I say I've been absent from school?

dialogue.content: 辛い思いで学校へ行かれているのですね。よく耐えているように感じます。
dialogue.English: So you’ve been going to school despite the pain. It seems you’re enduring a lot.

dialogue.content: ここで少しお話しをまとめてみてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we’ve talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは学校へ行く気がしないのを耐えて登校されているようです。それは数人の人達が無視して会話もない状況のようですね。ご両親も先生も頼りにならないようですね。あなた自身もじぶんがおかしいと思い込んでいるようです。
dialogue.English: It seems you are pushing yourself to attend school even though you don’t feel like going. This is happening in a situation where a few people are ignoring you and there’s no conversation. Your parents and teacher don’t seem to be reliable supports. You also seem to be convinced that there’s something wrong with you.

dialogue.content: あなたは自信をなくされているようにかんじますがいかがでしょうか？少しでも自分が出来たことを褒めてくださいね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you may have lost some confidence—does that resonate with you? Please try to praise yourself for even the small things you’re able to do.

dialogue.content: なんか無理矢理な感じがしますけどまあそんなところです
dialogue.English: It feels a bit forced, but I guess that's about right.

dialogue.content: 小さなことでいいですよ。実際にあなたは一生懸命に学校に行っています。そのことを自分で”良くい行ってきたと褒めてみて下さい。少しずつ元気になられるようことを願っています。
dialogue.English: Even small things are fine. You are actually trying very hard to go to school. Please try praising yourself for that, saying, 'I did a good job going today.' I hope that you'll start to feel better, little by little.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: また何かありましたらここへ来てお話ししてくださいね。いつでもいいですよ。
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please come back and talk to me. Anytime is fine.

dialogue.content: あるかどうかはわかりませんがそうします
dialogue.English: I don't know if anything will come up, but I'll do that.

dialogue.content: きょうは辛い気持ちを抱えてきてくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming and sharing your painful feelings with me today.

dialogue.content: これでロール―プレイを終了します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This concludes the role-play. Thank you very much.
